user.title: Connect to Solis Cloud
user.description: Enter your Solis Cloud API credentials

inverters.title: Select inverters
inverters.description: Select one to five inverters to monitor

reconfigure.title: Select inverters
reconfigure.description: Select one to five inverters to monitor. Saved API credentials are used only to refresh this list.

error.invalid_auth: SolisCloud denied API access. Check the API key, secret and account permissions.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the SolisCloud API. This can be a network or service problem.
error.timeout: The SolisCloud request timed out. Try again later.
error.server_error: SolisCloud returned a server error. Try again later; changing credentials will not fix this response.
error.rate_limited: SolisCloud is limiting API requests. Wait before trying again.
error.invalid_response: SolisCloud returned an unexpected response. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.
error.no_inverters: No inverters were returned for this API account. Check which devices are linked to it.
error.api_error: SolisCloud rejected the request. Check the API error code in the Home Assistant logs.
error.invalid_inverter_selection: Select only inverters linked to this account.
error.too_many_inverters: Select no more than five inverters.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already configured. Use the existing integration entry.
abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this API key is already in progress. Finish or close the other setup first.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The inverter selection was updated successfully.
